description.zh: 端侧SDK授权时必填的appKey信息：用户使用阿里云账号登陆SDK授权中心客户平台后，对已发放授权进行分配和新建批次后，会得到此appKey。
description.en: The appKey required for device-side SDK authorization. After you log on to the SDK Authorization Center customer platform with your Alibaba Cloud account and allocate or create a new batch for issued authorizations, you obtain this appKey.

description.zh: 端侧SDK授权时必填的DeviceId信息：设备的唯一标识，设备端开发接入时生成，需保证唯一且不变。
description.en: The DeviceId required for device-side SDK authorization. This is the unique identifier of the device, generated during device-side development integration. It must be unique and immutable.

description.zh: 其他扩展信息，JSON结构，方便后续扩展参数。
description.en: The additional extension information in JSON format for future parameter expansion.

description.zh: 端侧SDK授权时必填的SDKCode信息：每个发放的SDK授权都会有唯一的SDKCode信息，登录SDK授权中心客户平台后，可在授权列表获得此信息。
description.en: The SDKCode required for device-side SDK authorization. Each issued SDK authorization has a unique SDKCode. After you log on to the SDK Authorization Center customer platform, you can obtain this information from the authorization list.

description.zh: 用户填写的id信息，方便用户管理和记录的授权设备唯一标识，后续可用于排查用户侧授权出现的问题。
description.en: The user-specified ID that serves as a unique identifier for the authorized device. This helps you manage and track authorized devices and can be used to troubleshoot authorization issues on the user side.

title.en: Register and authorize a device SDK
